title: Vivid Vice
content:
I love it when MAL adds opening/ending theme songs as viable entries in its database. No complaints from me, but I’m not gonna pretend it did not throw me off at first and totally confuse me.

This is the opening theme song for the first season of Jujutsu Kaisen, and I think that is speaks volumes about it. At this point, it has become a staple in all of those trendy “Guess the Anime Song” videos you see online, a modern classic is the least we can say about it. Love it or hate it, it was and still is a hallmark of what makes theJujutsu Kaisen experiece. That might have sounded like glaze, but trust me, I have been watching Anime for long enough to notice trends rise and fade away, but this one did not.

It has it all. Visuals? Fantastic mix of 2D and 3D the likes you don’t see often in Anime. Great transitions, gripping direction and cinematography. it hardly feels like a battle Shounen at all.

The same and probably more can be said about the song itself. Arguably the star if of the show. I’m even humming and bobbing my head to my out of sync beeps as I type this review, feeling the song as though I have just heard it for the first dozens of times.
